rule: The Council convenes at full moon
texts: When the moon is full, the Council convenes at the Watch.
Whenever the moon is full, the Council meets at the Watch.

fields.sentence: When the moon is full, the Council convenes at the Watch.
parse: (: whenever_moon_full_council (Implication (And (Member $f full) (Experiencer $f sk_moon_1)) (And (Member (sk_convene $f) convene) (Agent (sk_convene $f) sk_council_1) (Location (sk_convene $f) sk_watch_1) (During (sk_convene $f) $f))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A copular/stative clause as the trigger of a when/whenever rule ('When the moon is full, ...'): the instruction set's list of state-reification triggers (resultative, connective endpoint, time modifier, adjective's PP complement, focus particle, approximator) does not include a rule premise, yet an eventuality witness is needed for the During link — and the dual-emit companion the flat copular rule otherwise demands cannot be emitted here, since a top-level `(Member sk_moon_1 full)` would assert the condition unconditionally.
review.notes: Routing 'when' over specific definite referents into a rule is right here — the clause is a genuine regularity, not a one-off narrative — and the sk_* premise constant is licensed because a top-level fact asserts it. 'the Council'/'the Watch' correctly stay common nouns with no Name atom, and the singular collective subject correctly gets no distribution rule.

fields.sentence: Whenever the moon is full, the Council meets at the Watch.
parse: (: whenever_moon_full_council_meets (Implication (And (Member $f full) (Experiencer $f sk_moon_1)) (And (Member (sk_meet $f) meet) (Agent (sk_meet $f) sk_council_1) (Location (sk_meet $f) sk_watch_1) (During (sk_meet $f) $f))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a COPULAR trigger clause in a whenever/every-time conditional ("whenever the moon is full"): the occurrence domain has to be a reified state, but the listed reification triggers are resultative / connective endpoint / time modifier / adjective PP complement / focus particle, and a rule premise is not among them — nor is it stated that the flat copular half of dual-emit must be suppressed here (asserting it would wrongly claim the moon is always full)
review.notes: Structure mirrors the bell/dog whenever exemplar exactly — definite participants stay constants while the rule ranges over occurrences, with the During link and (STV 1.0 0.9). "the Council" and "the Watch" correctly stay common nouns with no Name atoms, the singular collective takes a plain group filler with no distribution rule, and "at the Watch" is a Location oblique.
